principles.title: Core Studio OS Philosophy

principles.title: Experience Architecture™
principles.summary: The experiential layer — Studio Orb™, Living Headquarters™, Design DNA™, Experience DNA™, Workspace DNA™, Personalization DNA™, Emotional Computing™, Ambient Intelligence™, and context-aware personalization — is defined in experience-architecture.yaml as canonical architecture, not isolated design overlays.

principles.title: Foundation Governance™
principles.summary: Foundation Baseline v1.1 is frozen. All future architectural evolution requires governed Design Revisions, Constitutional Amendments, Master Specification updates, or new Volume additions — never silent modification of the baseline.

principles.title: Studio OS Release Channel System™
principles.summary: Studio OS supports Stable, Preview, Beta, and Experimental operating channels so organizations adopt capabilities at different speeds without affecting production stability. Every organization has an assigned Release Channel in its Organization Profile and System Registry. Studio Orb™, Studio Intelligence™, QA™, Experience Systems™, Marketplace™, Website Builder™, and all future modules must respect channel eligibility. QA Engine™, Update Engine™, and Deployment Engine™ are channel-native. Constitutional capability — not a product feature (CA-001).

principles.title: Company Genome™
principles.summary: Company Genome™ is the living DNA of every organization — the apex architectural object for creative identity. It is learned continuously from every interaction, never a static form. Project Genome™ extends it per production. Every Studio OS intelligence system must consult the Genome before generating anything. Creative direction precedes layout. Website generation is a final step — never the first. Studio OS must never produce generic experiences — every output must feel inevitable for that specific company. Constitutional capability (CA-002).

experienceArchitecture.summary: The experiential layer defines how Studio OS feels, adapts, and communicates — ambient intelligence, immersive Headquarters, design genomes, and respectful personalization. Company Genome™ (CA-002) is the apex identity layer above all genome systems. Product implementation of individual surfaces may be deferred; architectural definitions are canonical and frozen at Foundation v1.1.

releaseChannelSystem.summary: Studio OS supports multiple operating channels so organizations can safely adopt new capabilities at different speeds. Release Channel is a constitutional capability — not a product feature. Every organization receives an assigned channel. All modules, engines, and experience systems must respect channel eligibility before exposing functionality.

channels.title: Stable
channels.description: Production-ready. Fully validated. Recommended for live organizations operating customer-facing businesses with zero tolerance for experimental instability.

channels.title: Preview
channels.description: Feature-complete capabilities gathering production feedback before Stable promotion. Suitable for organizations willing to validate near-production surfaces with controlled exposure.

channels.title: Beta
channels.description: Major new capabilities undergoing broader validation. Organizations accept elevated change velocity in exchange for early access to platform evolution.

channels.title: Experimental
channels.description: Research features, prototype systems, and future architecture. No production guarantees. Sandbox and research organizations only.

organizationProfile.description: Every organization profile carries an assigned Release Channel. The channel governs which modules, routes, intelligence surfaces, and experience systems may activate for that tenant. Future organizations choose their channel at onboarding or via governed channel migration.

defaultAssignments.rationale: Live customer-facing brand — production stability required.
AI media lab — broader validation of knowledge and distribution capabilities.
Research and prototype workspace — no production guarantees.

nativeEngines.description: QA Engine™, Update Engine™, and Deployment Engine™ understand release channels natively — eligibility, promotion, and rollout decisions are channel-aware.

engines.title: QA Engine™
engines.description: Validates modules and surfaces against channel-specific QA gates before exposure. Stable requires full QA chain; Experimental requires constitutional registration only.

engines.title: Update Engine™
engines.description: Propagates Master Specification, manifest, and documentation updates through channel-aware rollout schedules — Preview and Beta receive updates before Stable.

engines.title: Deployment Engine™
engines.description: Governs build, release, and deployment promotion across channels. Stable deployments require Release Readiness™ approval; Experimental may deploy registered prototypes.

moduleEligibility.description: All modules must declare minimumReleaseChannel. Surfaces below the organization's assigned channel are hidden, disabled, or routed to upgrade guidance — never silently exposed.

platformGovernance.relationship: Platform Governance™ (M212) enforces extension review and policy. Release Channel System™ is the constitutional baseline that Platform Governance inherits for channel policy, promotion approvals, and cross-organization rollout discipline.

corePhilosophies.title: Environmental Storytelling™
corePhilosophies.summary: The environment communicates before interfaces do. Seasons, milestones, memory, and organizational moments should be felt through space, light, motion, and presence — not explained through dashboards or copy blocks.

corePhilosophies.title: Living Headquarters™
corePhilosophies.summary: Headquarters is a living place that evolves with the organization — not a static admin home. Departments, wings, pulse, and memory should change as the company grows, celebrates, and learns.

corePhilosophies.title: Studio Orb™
corePhilosophies.summary: Intelligence should feel ambient, respectful, and present — not trapped in a persistent toolbar. The Orb is a philosophy of presence: arrive, listen, guide, and disappear until needed again.

corePhilosophies.title: Experience Studio™
corePhilosophies.summary: Experience design is authored, interviewed, and refined — not configured through settings panels. Founders and executives shape atmosphere, tone, and feel through creative direction, not technical forms.

corePhilosophies.title: Design DNA™
corePhilosophies.summary: Every organization carries a visual and behavioral genome — canon, tokens, typography, glass, motion, and hierarchy that remain coherent across thousands of modules and future generations.

corePhilosophies.title: Experience DNA™
corePhilosophies.summary: Experience is inherited, not reinvented per screen. Emotional rhythm, arrival moments, hospitality, and environmental adaptation compose an Experience DNA that scales with the operating system.

corePhilosophies.title: Conversational UX
corePhilosophies.summary: The OS speaks naturally. Command, discovery, and guidance flow through conversation — voice, text, and concierge dialogue — before users hunt through menus or documentation indexes.

corePhilosophies.title: Invisible Complexity
corePhilosophies.summary: Sophisticated systems should feel simple. Registries, orchestration, policies, and intelligence pipelines remain engineering-visible — never user-visible complexity.

corePhilosophies.title: Executive-first Design
corePhilosophies.summary: Founders and executives are the primary audience. Every surface should support judgment, oversight, and strategic clarity before operator or developer convenience.

corePhilosophies.title: Documentation as Architecture
corePhilosophies.summary: Documentation is not an afterthought — it is part of the architecture. Knowledge, dependencies, and implementation status live in registries and manifest artifacts that are as authoritative as code.

corePhilosophies.title: AI as Collaborative Creative Director
corePhilosophies.summary: Studio Intelligence™ does not replace human judgment — it collaborates as a creative director: proposing, critiquing, refining, and explaining — while founders retain authorship and final decisions.

corePhilosophies.title: Single Source of Truth
corePhilosophies.summary: Every architectural object exists exactly once in the Master Specification and is referenced everywhere else. No duplicate milestone definitions, no parallel registries, no shadow roadmaps.

corePhilosophies.title: Progressive Disclosure
corePhilosophies.summary: Reveal depth only when needed. Onboarding, Headquarters, Command Dock, and intelligence surfaces should start calm and ceremonial — expanding into power as confidence grows.

corePhilosophies.title: Architecture Before Implementation
corePhilosophies.summary: Specify, register, and validate before building product surfaces. Volumes, chapters, milestones, philosophies, and design revisions precede routes, components, and feature work.

corePhilosophies.title: Operating System, Not SaaS
corePhilosophies.summary: Studio OS is an organizational operating system — not a subscription dashboard. Founders expand Headquarters, install Expansions, and hire digital staff; they do not buy apps, templates, or feature packs.

corePhilosophies.title: Places Instead of Pages
corePhilosophies.summary: Users walk through destinations — Headquarters wings, departments, floors, registries, and studios — not disconnected admin pages. Navigation is spatial and narrative, not a flat route tree.

corePhilosophies.title: Workspace DNA™
corePhilosophies.summary: Each organization workspace carries an experiential genome — isolated identity, atmosphere, and memory while inheriting Studio OS canon. Multi-organization does not mean multi-product fragmentation.

corePhilosophies.title: Personalization DNA™
corePhilosophies.summary: Personalization is respectful and explicit — culture, tone, accessibility, grief, celebration, and privacy preferences authored through Life & Culture Preferences™, never inferred from assumptions.

corePhilosophies.title: Emotional Computing™
corePhilosophies.summary: Intelligence systems account for emotional context — sensitivity, celebration, grief, and tone — as first-class inputs, not afterthoughts in copy generation.

corePhilosophies.title: Ambient Intelligence™
corePhilosophies.summary: Intelligence is felt through the environment — briefings, presence, and guidance arrive when needed and recede when not. No persistent toolbar clutter.

corePhilosophies.title: Context-Aware Experiences™
corePhilosophies.summary: Every surface adapts to organizational context — role, route, mission state, and executive priority — without requiring the user to reconfigure the OS.

corePhilosophies.title: Dynamic Workspace Personalization™
corePhilosophies.summary: Workspaces personalize atmosphere dynamically — seasons, milestones, and organizational moments reshape Headquarters while preserving canonical integrity.

corePhilosophies.title: Release Channel Governance™
corePhilosophies.summary: Organizations adopt platform capabilities at governed speeds — Stable for production, Preview for feedback, Beta for validation, Experimental for research. No module may bypass channel eligibility. Promotion requires QA Engine™, Update Engine™, and Deployment Engine™ channel-native approval — not ad-hoc feature flags.

corePhilosophies.title: Headquarters Engine™
corePhilosophies.summary: Every customer owns a Headquarters that grows over time. The Headquarters Engine generates immersive business environments tailored to business type — buildings, departments, workspaces, and operational rhythm — not apps or admin pages.

corePhilosophies.title: Headquarters Expansions™
corePhilosophies.summary: Businesses never outgrow Studio OS — they install Expansions. Each Expansion adds departments, workflows, AI specialists, concierges, automations, analytics, and progression systems into an existing Headquarters. Expansions are business capabilities, not templates or feature packs.

corePhilosophies.title: Headquarters Marketplace™
corePhilosophies.summary: Creators sell business architecture — living operational systems with UI, AI behavior, workflows, documentation, analytics, automation, and concierge roles. Not graphics, page templates, or downloadable files. Cross-industry installation is encouraged.

corePhilosophies.title: Business Headquarters Operating System
corePhilosophies.summary: Studio OS vision: the world's first immersive Business Headquarters Operating System. Founders step inside their business when they log in — not open software. Long-term goal is building businesses, not buying business software.

corePhilosophies.title: Meaningful Progression
corePhilosophies.summary: Borrow progression psychology from great games — ownership, production management, ambient intelligence, earned mastery — without gamification theater. Users feel they are building something alive; achievements reflect real organizational progress.

corePhilosophies.title: Company Genome™
corePhilosophies.summary: Every company has living DNA — not a logo, theme, or style guide. Company Genome™ is the apex identity object learned from every interaction. Studio OS must never create generic experiences. Outputs must feel inevitable for that specific company. Two companies generating the same product type must never receive interchangeable experiences.

corePhilosophies.title: Genome-First Intelligence
corePhilosophies.summary: Every AI system consults Company Genome™ and Project Genome™ before generating anything. Creative direction and editorial art direction precede layout, copy, and motion. Website generation is a final step. No intelligence may skip genome consultation. Rejected concepts teach the genome. Approved work strengthens it.
